_comment: Framework configuration and the provenance of the delivered rate card (D55). The RATES live in the delivered CSV at SCENARIO_FEES_SOURCE - feeRates.csv beside this file by default - one row per cell; the tiers and fee groups are derived from those rows. This file holds only what is not the delivering team's to say: the schedules, the level vocabulary in its order, the default level, the placeholder flag. Local adjustments are an overlay in the scenario store, never edits to the delivery.

schedules.note: One rate for every product, set by the top account size.
Each product priced by its fee group, set by the top account size.

delivery.source: placeholder card generated in-repo, not a delivery
